name: 06 - Response Tracking & Escalation
description: Daily job (9am) that finds letters past the FCRA 30-day window, re-ingests the updated credit report, evaluates outcomes via Claude, and either closes resolved cases or escalates to the next dispute round.

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT case_id
FROM dispute_letters
WHERE letter_status = 'mailed'
  AND fcra_response_due < now();

SELECT c.case_id, c.current_round,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ni.analysis_status = 'disputable' THEN 1 END) AS remaining_disputable
FROM cases c
LEFT JOIN negative_items ni ON ni.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}'
GROUP BY c.case_id, c.current_round;

nodes.name: DB: Update Case for Next Round

parameters.query: UPDATE cases SET case_status = '{{ $json.new_status }}', current_round = {{ $json.new_round }}, updated_at = now() WHERE case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}' RETURNING case_id, case_status, current_round;
INSERT INTO events (case_id, event_type, detail) VALUES ('{{ $json.case_id }}', '{{ $json.action }}', '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}'::jsonb);
